description: This file defines a class 'Env' that provides methods to retrieve environment-specific configuration variables, primarily focusing on the backend base URL. It uses the flutter_dotenv package to load environment variables and adjusts the URL for Android platform compatibility.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A class providing static methods to access environment variables and adjust backend URL based on platform.

methods.name: backendBaseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the backend base URL from environment variables, defaulting to an empty string if not set.

methods.name: effectiveBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns a platform-specific, sanitized URL for use in network requests, handling localhost remapping on Android.
